name: warrior-of-the-fae-realm-enter-decline-banish
notes: Warrior of the Fae Realm (eRcqucBKhX): "You MAY banish a Sword attack card". The MZMAYCHOOSE is answered PASS: the Striking Tides stays in hand, nothing is banished and no card is drawn into memory (memory holds only the 3 reserve payments).
